story: An icon of the skies, the Oriental Dollarbird (Eurystomus orientalis) is a species from the Coraciidae family. It thrives in Open woodland; forest edges; parks; gardens; mangroves; and riverine habitats, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Oriental Dollarbird is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Oriental Dollarbird helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Oriental Dollarbird, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
